prompt: Small ink marten, slender weasel-like animal standing on all four legs, glossy dark ink-black fur, a very long thick ink-black tail trailing behind it, cream-white muzzle and chest. Large upright rounded ears. The LEFT ear has a bright cream-white triangular notch cut out of its tip, clearly visible as a pale gap; the RIGHT ear is solid dark and whole. 3/4 top-down, chunky pixel art, 1px dark outline, light from top-left.

direction_prompts.north: seen from behind on all four legs, breathes gently, long tail sways; the cream notch stays in the tip of the ear on the viewer's left? no: its left ear is on the viewer's left when seen from behind
